instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\family_seed.dxf. Import family_seed.dxf. Draw three related plate variants in one DXF: rectangles (0,0)-(60,30), (80,0)-(150,40), and (170,0)-(260,50). Add one centered radius 5 hole in each plate at (30,15), (115,20), and (215,25), and add text ACAD-32. Use OUTLINE for plate rectangles, HOLE for holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
